body: FIELD+SOURCE findings on main 699ed29288ab2aa24463902fcefe752d432717d2: (1) Opening attempt WAKE_HINT at uptime 133873781; physical wake returns ok at +165ms; coarse PUBLIC_STANDARD 90 is accepted at +834ms and causes NATIVE_COVER->OPENING_FROM_CLOSED at +835ms; Samsung precise does not reacquire until 111deg at +1378ms. Field close generation45 reaches NATIVE_COVER, then +907ms an old Gen4 route owner generation42 is accepted/reasserted PREWARM_IN_FLIGHT.
